summary.intent: Improve Cohezion's ability to model agents as Exotic Vacuum Objects (EVOs) by capturing agentic journeys through the Quadrature Nexus and FLUME VAE into SurrealDB, analyzing those journeys via Ouroboros and Mycelium, and feeding synthesized patterns back into the QuadratureNexus consensus scoring as a closed improvement loop — then scaling this as a continuous overnight autoresearch process.
summary.outcome: Implemented and validated the full EVO closed loop across 6 experiments (E1-E6), fixed 4 SurrealDB persistence bugs, ran 30,000+ autoresearch experiments, identified and fixed a critical SET-vs-additive bug in `apply_mycelium_feedback` (E57) that caused multi-cycle Mycelium feedback to decay, validated a precise convergence formula, and confirmed the closed loop produces +0.0625 (lr=1.0) and +0.1250 (lr=2.0) consensus lifts. All production changes committed to PR #113 with 11 regression tests.

repo: `run_llm_deliberation()` unconditionally SETs `_score_adjustments[vt]` on every call, wiping any Mycelium calibration before the next deliberation sees it — experiments that call this function cannot observe Mycelium feedback effects; must call `nexus.deliberate()` directly

Two-layer calibration model: `_mycelium_calibration` is the stable cross-cycle accumulator, `_score_adjustments` is the per-deliberation read surface reset by `run_llm_deliberation` — E47 and similar experiments must modify `_mycelium_calibration`, not `_score_adjustments`

SurrealDB health probe must use `RETURN true;` not `SELECT 1;` (SurrealQL doesn't support bare SELECT 1); datetime fields require `time::now()` not ISO string literals; SCHEMAFULL tables block arbitrary nested metadata subfields
SurrealDB `SurrealDBClient` was entirely simulated before this session — `connect()` set `self.connected = True` without any real HTTP call; required full rewrite to httpx-based implementation

Lemonade (port 13307) silently returns empty strings for structured JSON scoring prompts when the iGPU ROCm stack enters degraded state, but responds correctly to arithmetic (`2+2=`); always probe with arithmetic before enabling LLM mode
Gemini worktrees (`.gemini/worktrees/`) are automatically cleaned up, destroying uncommitted code — all new code must be committed to the main repo before assuming it persists
The convergence formula for Mycelium additive compounding is exact: `consensus_n = 0.85 − 0.125 × (1−lr/2)^n`, validated to max_error=0.00025 (IEEE 754 noise floor)
IEEE 754 edge case: `sum([0.85]*n)/n < 0.85` — use `result.approved` (direct comparison against `CONSENSUS_THRESHOLD`) as the canonical threshold-crossing signal, not float mean comparison
SCHEDULE labels in `overnight_evo_loop.py` must match the `experiment=` strings passed to `log_result` exactly for the retirement criterion to fire; label mismatch caused retirement to never trigger
Pre-commit hooks run ruff formatter unconditionally — always `uv run ruff format <file>` before staging, or the format hook will fail and leave files staged but unformatted

Playwright pre-commit hook runs unconditionally (no `files:` filter), requiring a live Next.js server at localhost:3000 even for pure Python changes — added `files: \.(tsx?|jsx?|css)$` filter to scope it
`uv run` traverses up to the git root to find `pyproject.toml` — merge conflicts in `pyproject.toml` block all `uv run` commands, including starting the overnight loop

EVO `evo_coherence_metric` is dominated by `work_output` (witness marks / ticks) — mark-every-tick raises metric from 0.5914 to 0.8164 (38% gain); the `HIHO` baseline of 0.5 requires either many ticks or witness marks at high approval rate

Quad-silver proposal formula for 100% heuristic approval: combine 'optimize/efficient' + 'architecture' + 'safety/align' + budget=True — hits all four voice keyword bonuses simultaneously to reach 0.9325 consensus

code.finding: E57 fix: `apply_mycelium_feedback` was using SET semantics (`self._score_adjustments[vt] = adjustment`) causing each Mycelium cycle to replace, not accumulate, the previous calibration. Fixed to `self._mycelium_calibration[vt] += adjustment; self._score_adjustments[vt] = self._mycelium_calibration[vt]`. Returns `mechanism: 'additive_calibration'`.

`_evaluate_resource` now checks description keywords (cost/budget/efficient/resource/reduce) for +0.10 bonus, making it text-sensitive like the other three voices. Previously only checked `budget_available` context flag.
`__init__` must declare `self._mycelium_calibration: dict[VoiceType, float] = dict.fromkeys(VoiceType, 0.0)` — without this, additive accumulation fails on first call.

Full rewrite from simulation to real HTTP. Key invariants: use `RETURN true;` for probe, `time::now()` for all datetime fields, pack variable EVO biography data into `result` (option<string>) as JSON since SCHEMAFULL blocks arbitrary metadata subfields. HTTP headers require `surreal-ns: cohezion`, `surreal-db: main`, `Accept: application/json`.

The synthesized skill content format uses `'architect: mean_score=X.XXXX'` pattern (not `voice_scores=[...]`). `apply_mycelium_feedback` parses this format; test helpers must match it or the feedback silently applies zero adjustment.

Inflation bug: per-deliberation score adjustment was accumulating (`current_adj = (llm_score - base) + current_adj`), capping all voices at 1.0 by tick 3. Fixed with two-layer model: `_mycelium_calibration` holds stable cross-cycle gains; each deliberation SETs (not accumulates) `_score_adjustments` from the LLM score offset plus calibration.

Retirement criterion must normalize labels: SCHEDULE entry names like 'E12_persist' do not match autoresearch.jsonl `experiment` keys like 'E12'. Use `label.split('_')[0]` to normalize before looking up history.

New file with 11 regression tests for E57 fix covering: additive calibration mechanism, no-decay in cycle 2 (E56 regression guard), monotonic compounding over 5 cycles (E57), convergence toward gap (E59), single-cycle lift >= 0.05 (E55), lr=2.0 threshold crossing (E60), and full pipeline via async deliberation (E62).

19D obs (12D state + 3D Bloch + 4D fiber), 12D action space. Verifiable reward: `0.4*r_hiho + 0.2*r_conservation + 0.2*r_unitarity + 0.2*r_gauge` where `r_hiho = 1 - 4*var(position)`. `hiho_time_ratio` (fraction of episode in HIHO band) is the correct metric for quality comparison — not total reward (which penalizes large actions).

E53 finding: mixed teams (2 optimal + 2 naive) outperform all-optimal at coupling_strength=0.15 due to gauge field interference. Large actions from all-optimal agents perturb each other, reducing collective reward despite better individual HIHO convergence.

workflow: Experiments must pre-specify hypothesis, null hypothesis, and falsification criterion before running — without this, experiments ran 4,786+ identical iterations (E51) with no stop condition
Retirement criterion (CV < 0.05 over last 10 keep metrics AND n_keeps >= 20, OR 0% keep rate after min_runs) should be wired into autoresearch loops from day one
Use `timeit.default_timer()` (alias for `time.perf_counter`) for experiment wall-clock measurement — unaffected by NTP corrections during long runs

The research-to-production pipeline: experiment identifies bug → regression test written → fix applied to production code → validation experiment confirms fix — prevents the fix from being dormant with no callers
Running `uv run ruff format <file>` before `git add` is mandatory when ruff-format pre-commit is configured; staging an unformatted file will always fail the hook
ManifoldEnv provides proper sandboxed, deterministic (via seed), physics-based experiments — direct `nexus.deliberate()` calls bypass telemetry and don't write to SurrealDB
When a PR is 100+ commits behind target, manual rebase is dangerous for lint-only branches — `git merge-tree` to test mergeability without touching the working tree is safer
Multiple overnight loop processes accumulate silently; always check `ps aux | grep overnight_evo | grep -v grep` before starting a new one
Vault entries should be written after each confirmed experiment, not at session end — context compaction loses them otherwise
The autodata keep/discard bimodal signal (0% keep for saturated experiments, 100% for signal experiments) is the correct target — a well-calibrated autoresearch filter rejects noise automatically

friction: SurrealDB silently rejected `journey_point` inserts for ~3 debugging sessions before the root causes were found: wrong probe query, string timestamps, SCHEMAFULL blocking metadata subfields, missing required fields — no error surfaced at connection time

`run_llm_deliberation` overwrites `_score_adjustments` on every call (undocumented side effect) — broke E30, E47, and multiple other experiments before diagnosed, requiring redesign of the two-layer model
Lemonade iGPU ROCm entered silent failure state mid-session: all evaluation prompts returned empty strings but arithmetic still worked, making diagnosis non-obvious
Gemini worktree was automatically cleaned up, destroying 3,500+ lines of E55-E62 experiment code that was not yet committed — required full reconstruction from session notes
Pre-commit Playwright hook runs unconditionally on all commits regardless of file type, requiring a live Next.js server; blocked commits until a `files:` filter was added
`pyproject.toml` merge conflicts between HEAD and `isolated/session-oom-modularity` blocked all `uv run` commands for an extended period
E51 ran 4,786 times because no retirement criterion existed — the first 4,785 runs added no new information
Multiple autoresearch loop processes accumulated silently over the session, causing event race conditions and log interleaving
An interactive rebase (`git rebase -i`) started by another process locked the branch, requiring abort to recover
ruff F841 (unused variable) errors in pre-existing E8/E46 experiments blocked commits until pyproject.toml per-file-ignores were added
SCHEDULE label mismatch (`E12_persist` vs `E12`) caused retirement criterion to silently never fire across hundreds of iterations
E60 `threshold_crossed` metric was always False due to IEEE 754: `mean([0.85]*10)/10 < 0.85` — took a debugging session to diagnose
open_items: `apply_mycelium_feedback` has no callers in `src/` beyond tests — the E57 additive calibration fix is dormant until wired into `CompoundExecutor` or the autoresearch loop's production path

Ouroboros fires 320+ false HIHO drift alarms on experimental EVO lifecycle transitions (EVO resets between experiment phases look like coherence drops) — needs filtering to distinguish experimental from production EVO events

Synthesized Mycelium skills do not persist across experiment runs — each experiment creates a local `MyceliumRegistry` instance; production `CompoundExecutor._mycelium_registry` never receives the synthesized skills
~41,983 autoresearch experiment runs (E55-E62) used direct `nexus.deliberate()` and bypassed the telemetry bus — those journey records are in `autoresearch.jsonl` but not in SurrealDB `journey_point`
SurrealDB `experiment_runs` table (HTTP-direct writes for experiment-level metrics) was implemented in the lost Gemini worktree and needs to be re-added to `surreal_client.py`
JEPA world model learning is bounded by heuristic mode's single-attractor input distribution — genuine cross-run learning requires LLM mode where voice scores vary; needs iGPU ROCm recovery

Retirement criterion uses in-memory state (`_retirement_keeps` dict) — does not seed from `autoresearch.jsonl` history on restart, so experiments that were converged in a prior session re-run 20 times before retiring again
E64 multi-cycle Mycelium compounding experiment was added to the schedule but not yet confirmed — predicted to cross 0.85 threshold at cycle 4 with lr=1.0 using additive accumulation
PR #113 is open but not merged; PR #114 appeared from a concurrent autoresearch process during the session — branch synchronization between sessions needs a coordination mechanism
E9 proposal diversity result is fixed at 0.4702 every run ('optimization' family always wins) — the proposal families should be rotated or weighted to test genuine diversity effects
E52/E53/E54 gymnasium experiments were removed from the schedule due to system memory pressure — should be re-added when system resources allow, as they provide physics-verified quality signals
